anomalies.description: A figure in a light-colored jacket fires a weapon, producing visible muzzle flash and sparks near a metallic structure; another person is nearby.; A person in dark clothing aims and fires a weapon toward the right, with bright muzzle flash and sparks visible; background shows industrial setting with fire.; A figure raises arms holding a firearm upward; muzzle flash and smoke are visible, indicating discharge in an enclosed industrial space.; A person in dark attire fires a weapon from behind cover; smoke and muzzle flash are visible near machinery.
A bright burst of sparks and debris (consistent with an explosion or detonation) occurs near the left side of the frame, coinciding with the shooting; sustained spark shower visible across f2–f6.
A silhouetted figure runs while firing a weapon, producing sustained bright sparks and muzzle flashes in a narrow corridor; multiple frames show continuous gunfire effects.

A sustained burst of bright sparks and debris erupts in the background as a figure runs through a corridor; the visual characteristics (intense, localized, rapidly expanding incandescent particles) indicate an explosion or detonation event.
A large, bright blue explosion with radiating light beams and flying debris/sparks occurs behind a silhouetted figure; the intensity and sudden onset indicate a detonation event.

A man (Tom Cruise) is shown in motion, turning rapidly with sparks and debris around him, consistent with evading or engaging in close-quarters combat during an explosive incident; his posture and movement suggest active physical confrontation.
